title: Beyond Disinformation: Strategic Misrepresentation across Content, Actors, Processes, and Covertness
reasoning: The paper focuses on a conceptual framework for strategic misrepresentation and surveys detection techniques for disinformation. While it uses concepts from epistemology ('epistemic diligence') and mentions religion as a protected category in the context of hate speech detection, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or frameworks within the AI systems themselves.
